# Summary

Machine learning researcher building privacy-preserving, federated clinical AI at the Institute for AI in Medicine (IKIM), University Hospital Essen. PhD in Neuroscience (UBC) applying machine learning to overdose risk prediction. 13 peer-reviewed journal articles (6 first-author; 412 citations), an accepted NeurIPS 2026 workshop paper, a CRAN package, and two years as a primary instructor in UBC's Master of Data Science.

# Experience

\role{Postdoctoral Researcher}{IKIM, University Hospital Essen, Germany}{Jul 2026 -- Present}

- Build federated chronic kidney disease risk prediction across general practices with Flower, patient-level DP-SGD, and SecAgg+ (FLIP-IT, EU/NRW-funded); jointly supervised by Prof. Jens Kleesiek and Prof. Michael Kamp.
- Develop privacy-preserving federated continual learning methods and an open-source benchmark toolkit, so clinical models learn from distributed hospital data without catastrophic forgetting.
- Investigate federated protocols that transmit activation and rank codes instead of parameters, with pre-registered controls and explicit communication-bitrate accounting.

\role{Postdoctoral Teaching and Learning Fellow}{UBC Master of Data Science and Statistics}{Jul 2024 -- Jun 2026}

- Primary instructor for 10 courses reaching 550+ students, including Data Visualization (DSCI 531), Probability (DSCI 551, STAT 302), Databases and SQL (DSCI 513), and Communication and Argumentation (DSCI 542).
- Supervised 5 industry and clinical capstone teams (BC Children's Hospital, Vaccine Evaluation Center, Creative Destruction Lab, UBC Cybersecurity, Nautical Crime Investigation Services); the vessel-trajectory project was published in *Engineering Applications of AI* (2026; corresponding author).
- Co-authored *The Regression Cookbook* (UBC OER Fund); built the statistical framework (cumulative link mixed models) for a TLEF-funded AI literacy study; designed PrairieLearn assessments and Quarto course sites.

\role{Data Science Consultant (freelance, part-time)}{Clause Technology}{Jul 2025 -- Oct 2025}

- Built HAVA, a maritime criminal detection system with NCIS: automated web scraping, NLP incident classification, and LLM-assisted de-duplication (BERT, NER, fuzzy matching) on a Dockerized MongoDB/PostgreSQL stack.
- Prototyped a computer vision and OCR pipeline for structured extraction from complex PDF tables.

\role{Data Scientist}{Concussion RX, Vancouver}{Apr 2024 -- Sep 2024}

- Applied machine learning and statistical modelling to concussion subtype analysis; wrote clinical onboarding materials.

\role{Graduate Researcher (PhD)}{Addiction and Concurrent Disorders Group, UBC}{Sep 2019 -- Apr 2024}

- Built overdose risk models (RF, XGBoost, SVM; N = 36,679; 91.1% AUROC) for RAMP, a CAD 1.4M Health Canada platform (co-investigator).
- First-authored a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical decision support in addiction care (2024); keynotes at the 2nd International Psychiatry Congress (Egypt) and Virtual Solutions for Substance Use Care; visiting researcher at the University of Sydney Brain and Mind Centre (Mitacs Globalink).
